title: Dynamic Scapular & Resistance Band Warmup
instructions: Perform 2 sets of 12 band pull-aparts, 10 external rotations per shoulder, and 10 full-draw resistance band holds focusing on depressing the bow-side scapula before picking up the bow.

title: Blank Bale Elastic Expansion Warmup
instructions: Shoot 4 ends of 3 arrows at a 3m blank bale with no target face. Focus on smooth angular transfer into the rhomboids and lower trapezius with a relaxed release hand.

title: Blank Bale Closed-Eyes Scapular Draw & Clicker Expansion
instructions: At 3m blank bale, come to anchor, close both eyes, and expand continuously through the clicker (or 2-second expansion cue for barebow) feeling the draw elbow move behind the arrow line.

title: Bow-Arm Post-Shot Follow-Through & Grip Pressure Bale Drill
instructions: Set pressures exclusively on the thener eminence (45-degree knuckles) with relaxed fingers. Maintain active forward pressure toward the boss for 2 full seconds after arrow release.

title: Compound Back-Tension / Hinge Surprise Release Bale Fix
instructions: At 3m blank bale using a hinge or resistance release (or thumb button without conscious punching), settle firmly against the back wall and pull steadily through the back until surprise ignition occurs within 4-6 seconds.

title: Consistent Facial Reference, String Alignment & Vertical Bow Check
instructions: At 5m blank bale with a vertical plumb-line tape on the boss, verify solid jawbone/string-to-nose contact and vertical bow limb alignment before executing a clean expansion.

title: Poundage Step-Up Short-Range Blank Bale Adaptation
instructions: Mandatory <=5m mechanical poundage adaptation block. Shoot controlled 4-arrow ends at 3m-5m blank bale, prioritizing low bow-shoulder alignment and full skeletal wedge lock under increased draw weight.

title: SPT Holding — 30s Isometric Full-Draw Stability
instructions: With an arrow on the bow pointed safely at a 3m boss (or using a bow trainer strap), draw to anchor and hold full draw for 30 seconds while keeping the bow shoulder down, followed by 60 seconds rest for 8 reps.

title: SPT Endurance — 15s Hold / 15s Rest Live-Release Repeats
instructions: Draw to anchor, hold strong back tension for 12-15 seconds, and execute a clean shot into the 5m bale. Rest 15 seconds between arrows for 3 sets of 6 arrows.

title: SPT Power — Explosive Draw to 5s Clicker / Wall Check & Shoot
instructions: Draw powerfully to within 1mm of the clicker edge, hold motionless for 5 seconds verifying zero shoulder elevation, then expand decisively through the clicker to shoot.

title: SPT Compound Peak-Weight & Back-Wall Holding Conditioning
instructions: Draw smoothly over peak weight into the holding valley, hold steady dot float on a 5m spot for 20 seconds without creeping forward, then execute a clean back-tension shot; rest 40 seconds.

title: WA 720 Qualification Stamina — 12 Ends x 6 Arrows Timed (240s)
instructions: Shoot a full 72-arrow WA 720 round (12 ends of 6 arrows in 4 minutes per end on a 122cm face at 70m for Recurve / 50m for Barebow). Log granular arrow values (X, 10, 9...M) to track 1st-half vs. 2nd-half decay.

title: WA Compound 50m 720 Stamina & X-to-10 Ratio Optimization
instructions: Shoot 12 ends of 6 arrows at 50m on the WA 80cm 6-ring target face under strict 240-second end timing. Record every X and 10 to compute X-to-10 conversion ratio and second-half stamina stability.

title: WA 18m Indoor Triple-Spot Shot-Clock & Mandatory Let-Down
instructions: Shoot 20 ends of 3 arrows (120s per end) at 18m on a 40cm vertical triple-spot face. Any shot not released within 8 seconds of reaching anchor MUST be let down and restarted.

title: Double-End WA 720 Stamina Overload (6 Ends x 6 Arrows Rapid Cadence)
instructions: Shoot 6 scored ends of 6 arrows at competition distance with reduced 180-second end clocks to build tournament shot-rhythm efficiency and late-round postural resilience.

title: WA Recurve & Barebow Set-System Match Play Simulation
instructions: Simulate a World Archery Olympic/Barebow Set-System elimination match: 3 arrows per set (20 seconds per arrow alternating timing), 2 set points for a set win, 1 point for a tie, first to 6 set points (up to 5 sets / 15 arrows).

title: WA Compound 15-Arrow Cumulative Match Play Simulation
instructions: Simulate a World Archery Compound elimination match using Cumulative Scoring: 5 ends of 3 arrows (15 arrows total, 150 max score, 20 seconds per arrow alternating timing; inner-10 ring active when shot at 18m indoor).

title: Decompression Controlled Let-Down & Antagonist Cooldown
instructions: Shoot 6 relaxed blank-bale arrows focusing on effortless follow-through, followed by 5 slow 10-second eccentric let-downs and thoracic/pectoral stretching to restore resting muscle tone.
